summary.method: Each quote source classified by domain: primary (the person's own site, official transcripts, podcasts, testimony, papers), press (major news outlets), community (forums, blogs), tertiary (quote aggregators/wikis). Every quote, interview and key-work URL was requested on 2026-10-20: live = HTTP 200; protected = site blocks automated checks (403/429/406/401), likely live; unreachable = timeout/error. YouTube ids verified via YouTube oEmbed. Score = 50% source quality + 25% link health + 15% source breadth + 10% no unverified flags. A heuristic of sourcing strength, not a judgement of the person.
